reason: We sell with photos of finished homes and buyers have never asked to see a home before it's built, so I have no pain this fixes. And with a library of 50+ plans, $1,500 a pop plus $500 every time the client changes something adds up fast.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? $500 a round on top of $1,500, across dozens of plans, for something my buyers have never asked for.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that buyers actually close faster or pay more for upgrades with it, and a flat per-plan price for the whole library with free revisions on our standard option changes.
